description: This file defines the 'Authorized' annotation used in the OpenMRS core project to specify security requirements for service layer methods and classes, such as required privileges and authentication status.

classes.name: Authorized
classes.description: Annotation used to specify security privileges and requirements for methods or classes in the OpenMRS service layer.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Returns the list of privileges needed to access the annotated method or class.

methods.name: requireAll
methods.description: Indicates whether the user must have all listed privileges ('true') or any one of them ('false') to access the method or class.
